questions.question: Which type of material needs a transport index?
questions.explanation: Some radioactive materials must have a transport index. A transport index is a number that shows how much control a material needs during transport. The total transport index of all cargo in one vehicle cannot be more than 50.

questions.question: If hazardous materials cargo is on fire, you should:

options.text: Try to put it out with a fire extinguisher.
Call emergency personnel and let them fight the fire.
Hope the fire goes out on its own.

questions.correctAnswerText: Call emergency personnel and let them fight the fire.
questions.explanation: Fighting a hazardous materials fire requires special training and gear. Do not try to fight the fire yourself unless you have proper equipment and training.

questions.question: Where can hazardous materials shipping papers be kept?

options.text: In a pouch attached to the driver's side door.
Taped to the passenger's side window.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a pouch attached to the driver's side door.
questions.explanation: Keep shipping papers in a pouch on the driver's side door or in a place where the driver can reach them easily while wearing a seat belt. The papers must be easy to see for anyone entering the cab.

questions.question: What shape is a hazardous materials placard?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials warning placards are diamond-shaped.

questions.question: What shape are hazardous materials placards?
questions.explanation: Vehicles carrying hazardous materials must display diamond-shaped warning signs on all four sides. These signs are called placards.

questions.question: When packaging hazardous materials, a shipper certifies that:

options.text: The package does not contain hazardous materials.
The package was prepared according to the rules.
The package was packed at a different location.

questions.correctAnswerText: The package was prepared according to the rules.
questions.explanation: A shipper of hazardous materials must state on the shipping paper that the shipment was prepared following all the rules.

questions.question: If a driver leaves their vehicle while transporting hazardous materials, the shipping papers should:

options.text: Be left on the front seat of the cab.
Be placed in a box under the passenger seat.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be left on the front seat of the cab.
questions.explanation: When a driver leaves their vehicle, the hazardous materials shipping papers must stay on the driver's seat.

questions.question: If the letter "G" appears in Column 1 of a hazardous materials shipping paper, what else must be included?

options.text: The technical name of the hazardous materials.
The type of packaging containing the hazardous materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: The technical name of the hazardous materials.
questions.explanation: A "G" in Column 1 means the name in Column 2 is a generic name. A generic shipping name must include a technical name.

questions.question: What shape are hazardous materials placards?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials warning placards are diamond-shaped.

questions.question: How must a hazardous waste manifest be signed?

options.text: On the outside of the trailer.

questions.explanation: When transporting hazardous waste, you must carry a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest. It must be signed by hand.

questions.question: Shippers package hazardous materials to ____.

options.text: Keep them safe inside the package

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep them safe inside the package
questions.explanation: Shippers package hazardous materials to keep them completely safe inside the package. Vehicles carrying these materials must have warning signs to show what the cargo is.

questions.question: Before loading or unloading flammable liquids, you should:
questions.explanation: Always turn off the engine before loading or unloading flammable liquids. The only exception is if you need the engine running to operate a pump.

questions.question: A sign that cargo contains hazardous materials is:

options.text: The cargo is in cylinder tanks.
The cargo comes from a supermarket.
The cargo is in cardboard boxes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cargo is in cylinder tanks.
questions.explanation: The type of package can tell you if materials are hazardous. Cylinders and drums are commonly used to store and move hazardous materials.

questions.question: A clue that your shipment may contain hazardous materials is:

options.text: The shipper sells fireworks or explosives.
Your last shipment was labeled as hazardous.

questions.correctAnswerText: The shipper sells fireworks or explosives.
questions.explanation: A clue that a shipment may contain hazardous materials is the type of business the shipper is in. Businesses that deal with these materials include paint suppliers, chemical companies, pest control services, farm suppliers, and explosives or fireworks dealers.

questions.question: ____ is responsible for properly labeling hazardous materials.
questions.explanation: The shipper must package, mark, and label hazardous materials correctly. The driver should check that the materials are labeled properly.

questions.question: Placards must be placed:

options.text: Within three inches of other markings.
So you can read the words or numbers from left to right.

questions.correctAnswerText: So you can read the words or numbers from left to right.
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials placards must be at least three inches away from any other markings. They must be level so that the words or numbers read from left to right.

questions.question: A person watching a placarded vehicle may be:

options.text: Either awake or asleep inside the vehicle.

questions.explanation: A person watching a parked placarded vehicle must be awake inside the vehicle or within 100 feet of it. If outside the vehicle, the person must be able to see it clearly. The person cannot be in the sleeper berth.

questions.question: What does a shipping paper describe?

options.text: How the materials will be transported
Who should receive the materials being transported

questions.explanation: Shipping papers must describe the specific hazardous materials being transported, along with other important information.

questions.question: Who must mark and label materials for shipping?
questions.explanation: Shippers of hazardous materials must warn drivers and others about the risks. They do this by putting hazard labels on packages, placing warning signs on vehicles, and providing shipping papers and emergency information.

questions.question: How often must hazardous materials employees be trained and tested?
questions.explanation: All drivers must be trained on the risks of transporting hazardous materials. This includes how to spot and respond to security threats. Hazardous materials employees must be trained and tested at least once every three years.

questions.question: A driver should make sure that:

options.text: The shipping paper matches the markings and labels on the packages.
The shipping paper is written in code.
All packages are labeled as poison.

questions.correctAnswerText: The shipping paper matches the markings and labels on the packages.
questions.explanation: Always check that package markings and labels match the shipping papers. Make sure the shipper has written the correct description on the shipping paper and placed the proper labels on the packages.

questions.question: Many poison products are also:
questions.explanation: Many poisonous hazardous materials are also flammable.

questions.question: When transporting hazardous materials, how should a shipper warn others?

options.text: Post HazMat placards on the truck.
Put flashing lights on the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Post HazMat placards on the truck.
questions.explanation: Shippers must display diamond-shaped warning signs called placards on vehicles carrying hazardous materials. Shippers must provide placards, labels, shipping papers, and emergency response information.

questions.question: When loading compressed gas, the liquid discharge valves should be:
questions.explanation: Keep liquid discharge valves open only during loading and unloading. Close them at all other times.

questions.question: You may leave a vehicle carrying explosives unattended only:

options.text: On the shoulder of a highway.

questions.explanation: You may only leave a vehicle with explosives unattended in a safe haven. A safe haven is an approved location for parking vehicles loaded with explosives.

questions.question: ____ are used to warn others about hazardous materials.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs called placards are placed on packages and vehicles to warn drivers and others about hazardous materials. The shipper places the placards. The driver verifies they are correct.

questions.question: Hazardous materials may be transported by:

options.text: A driver with a CDL and hazardous materials endorsement.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver with a CDL and hazardous materials endorsement.
questions.explanation: You must have a CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement to transport hazardous materials in any vehicle.

questions.question: How often must hazardous materials employees be trained?

options.text: At least once every three years

questions.correctAnswerText: At least once every three years
questions.explanation: Employees who work with hazardous materials must be trained and tested at least once every three years.

questions.question: How do you label a package when the hazardous materials label will not fit on it?

options.text: Place the label on a tag securely attached to the package.
Attach a QR Code to be scanned.
Reduce the size of the HazMat label to fit on the package.

questions.correctAnswerText: Place the label on a tag securely attached to the package.
questions.explanation: If a diamond-shaped hazard label will not fit on a package, place it on a tag that is securely attached to the package.

questions.question: Unless excepted, a shipping paper must include:

options.text: The location of fire departments along the planned route.

questions.explanation: Unless excepted, hazardous materials shipping papers must include an emergency response telephone number.
